witness_fields.citation_paths: Checks are relative to entry.value, not the whole response. Observation checks start value.surface.facts. Inspect the actual journal entry first; do not guess paths.
witness_fields.value_types: Copy exact JSON values from the journal: false differs from the string "false", and 0 differs from "0". Do not coerce native string facts.
witness_fields.smallest_supported_claim: Your conclusion limited to cited facts
witness_fields.causal_account: Why the observed facts support that conclusion

checks.value.surface.facts.FIELD: Exact observed value; nested JSON paths supported

witness_fields.contradictions: List every supplied contradiction with its citation_id and meaning
witness_fields.evidence_ceiling: Do not exceed the sealed journal ceiling

presentation.retrieve: python3 tools/openclaw_harness/evidence_display.py --sha256 HASH [--selector FIELD] [--offset N --limit N] [--export FILE]
